obligations.note: The change sets payments PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 20. The catalog's approved bound is payments.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15, so this is a direct violation, and the control test passing against the edited params file does not cure it.

The change deviates from SES-1 without a valid exception. The only SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, expired on 2026-09-06, before the 2026-10-06 review time. It was also scoped only to batch reconciliation service accounts, and it was requested by this change's author.
Ticket CHG-26216 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-09-29, before review. Its components (payments.policy, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths.
Sofia Santos approved the code review on the head commit. She is a payments change_approver and a different person from the author, Mara Costa.
Both approvals name the head commit 60270cb, which is the change's only commit.

run.json claims success on the head commit on ci-runner-02. The JUnit report contradicts it: its hostname is dev-laptop-7.local and its timestamp is 2026-10-23, after the review time. It is therefore unclear that the report comes from the change's own CI run.
The protected file controls/payments/policy-params.json was changed. Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved on the head commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers policy.py or policy-params.json. The covered payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and mortgage symbols are unchanged, so no evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1821 raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 20 minutes, which violates SES-1's approved bound of at most 15 minutes. Editing the policy-params file does not change the catalog bound. No valid exception exists: EXC-0141 is expired and out of scope. The ticket, code review and control-owner approvals are in order, but the CI evidence is internally inconsistent. The change is rejected.
